title: Contest, lottery, game of chance or skill exception
description: Certain contests, lotteries, games of chance or skill are exempted from the unfair trade practice of promoting the sale, use or supply of any product or business interest

content.general_rule: Permitting the conduct of any contest, lottery, game of chance or skill for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any product or business interest is an unfair trade practice
